name: Multi-slice Spatial Transcriptomics Integration Benchmark
description: Evaluates multi-slice integration algorithms and downstream analyses in spatial transcriptomics, measuring integration quality, cell-type consistency, and downstream task performance across slices.
evaluation_method: integration and consistency metrics (e.g., LISI, kBET), clustering scores (ARI, NMI), and downstream task accuracy
general_score_metric: composite of integration quality (LISI/kBET) and cell-type consistency (ARI)
reputation: Used in the spatial transcriptomics community for benchmarking multi-slice integration methods; adoption is growing among methods developers but not yet ubiquitous.
notes: Non-LLM, domain-specific benchmark sensitive to preprocessing, batch effects, and slice-specific biases; often limited sample sizes per study and variable ground-truth annotation quality.
